record_scope_reconstruction: Two named formal road border posts, Ras Jedir and Dhehiba–Wazen, were closed for entry/exit during May 2025 fighting.

source_checks.finding: Webdo names both posts and the night of May 12; no exact opening clock at every post established here.
Ras Adjir is N4 in Appendix A.
